##### Project general facts

Merdan Residences is a residential tower by Evera Development, rising above a landscaped podium with light façades, balconies and a calm, contemporary architectural expression. The building brings together studio, one-bedroom, two-bedroom and three-bedroom apartments, with efficient layouts designed for everyday comfort and family living.

The podium level forms the social heart of the residence, with a swimming pool, a separate kids' pool, family cabanas and podium seating areas set within a green oasis. A fitness centre, a yoga and meditation area, a sauna and steam zone, an outdoor cinema, a basketball court, a barbecue area and a children's play area support active and relaxed routines, while smart security systems help keep the building protected.

Inside, the apartments combine living and dining areas with kitchens, bedrooms and well-planned bathrooms, while many units open onto private balconies. Larger layouts add dressing areas, store rooms and laundry space, giving households extra room for storage and daily organisation.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Sports City is a master-planned community built around sport and active living, home to the Els Club golf course, professional sports academies and Dubai Cricket Stadium. Residential streets sit alongside villas and green golf landscapes, giving the neighbourhood an open and relaxed character.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Al Khail Road and Sheikh Zayed Road provide quick connections to Dubai Marina, Mall of the Emirates and The Dubai Mall. International schools such as Queen Elizabeth's School, healthcare centres, retail outlets and community hubs cover daily needs, while Sports City Lake and the community's green spaces offer space for walks and outdoor recreation.

The community attracts families and professionals looking for spacious homes close to schools, sports facilities and major road networks. Its family-friendly setting supports demand from both residents and tenants, making Dubai Sports City a practical choice for end users and investors alike.
